summary: Tested new GET /api/insights/sales endpoint and new 'Product Sales Insights' section on /insights page. All backend tests (22/22) and frontend interactions passed. No regressions on existing insights endpoints.

design_issues.screen: Sales Insights — Top Selling Brand KPI / Top Brands table
issues: Almost all products in the dataset have empty brand strings, so the aggregation collapses ~9,252 of 9,276 estimated units into a single 'Unknown' bucket (99.9% market share) and the Top Selling Brand KPI displays literally 'Unknown'. This is a data quality/UX concern, not a code defect — the endpoint correctly groups empty brands. Consider (a) filtering 'Unknown' out of top_brand selection on the server so the KPI shows the top named brand, or (b) hiding the Unknown row from the Top Brands table.

Backend: kpis include total_units_sold (int), total_revenue (float), avg_revenue_per_product (float), top_brand (str|null), product_count (int)
Backend: products items contain all 10 required fields (sku, name_ar, name_en, brand, qty_sold_est, revenue_est, avg_price, num_sellers, stock_signal, confidence_score)
Backend: top_brands items contain {brand, units_sold, revenue_est, market_share_pct}; sum of market_share_pct = 100.0 (within tolerance)
Backend: days=7|14|30|90 all return 200
Backend: date_from + date_to range query returns 200
Backend: sort=revenue_desc — first 3 products sorted DESC by revenue_est
Backend: sort=sales_asc — first 3 products sorted ASC by qty_sold_est
Backend: search='xyznevermatches' returns 0 products; brand substring search returns matching results
Backend: cross-check — insights/sales total_units_sold == my-products total_units_sold (both 9,276 for days=30) confirming wrapper reuses my_products() logic
Backend regression: /api/my-products?days=30 still 200 with full shape (kpis, products, total, limit, offset, categories)
Backend regression: /api/insights/summary, /insights/leaderboard, /insights/top-sellers, /insights/trending, /insights/gaps, /insights/price-wars, /insights/restock-opportunities all return 200
Frontend: /insights page loads without freeze; all existing cards (freshness-card, revenue-leaderboard, etc.) still render
Frontend: data-testid='sales-insights-section' present below existing cards
Frontend: 4 KPI cards render with non-empty values (si-kpi-total_units='9,276', si-kpi-total_revenue='413K SAR', si-kpi-avg_revenue='827 SAR', si-kpi-top_brand='Unknown')
Frontend: Top Brands table renders with brand/units/revenue/share-bar; visible market share % sums to 100.0
Frontend: Per-product table renders 500 rows with all 8 columns (product, brand, sales, revenue, avg price, sellers, stock badge, confidence)
Frontend: Search debounce — 'xyznevermatches' → 0 rows + empty marker; 'Z.1' → 151 rows
Frontend: Sort dropdown — revenue_desc row0=14K SAR/175 sales → sales_asc row0=0 SAR/0 sales (order changed)
Frontend: Day pill 7D changes Sales Insights total_units from 9,276 → 0 (filter consumed)
Frontend: insights-date-from + insights-date-to (2026-04-01..2026-05-22) overrides day pill — total_units becomes 14,914
Frontend: insights-date-clear button restores default days behavior (units back to 9,276)
Frontend: 0 console errors during all interactions
Frontend: existing testids (freshness-card, revenue-leaderboard) still present after interactions
action_items: OPTIONAL: handle 'Unknown' (empty) brand in /api/insights/sales — either skip it when picking top_brand or filter it out of top_brands list so the UI shows a meaningful brand instead of literally 'Unknown' dominating 99.9% market share.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2492 insights_sales — passes search=None to my_products() and then re-applies search locally; this is intentional/documented and works, but means search filter happens after the 500-row cap. With current seed (9,276 units across 7,303+ products) the cap could theoretically truncate before search. Not a blocker but worth noting.

SalesInsights.jsx:44 — useMemo is used to set up a debounce timer; this works because useMemo runs on dependency change, but useEffect is the semantically correct hook for side effects. Cosmetic, not breaking.
InsightsPage.jsx:396 — passes dateFrom/dateTo only when BOTH are set, which correctly matches the documented behavior (custom range only feeds the new section). Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all new section interactions verified + no console errors + no regressions)

context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend endpoint /api/insights/sales is a thin wrapper around my_products() that adds top_brands aggregation + market_share_pct. Frontend new component /app/frontend/src/components/SalesInsights.jsx is mounted at the bottom of InsightsPage.jsx and consumes days|dateFrom|dateTo props. The dateFrom/dateTo inputs in the page header ONLY feed the new section (by design). Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_insights_sales.py covers shape, behavior, cross-check with my-products, and regression on 8 existing endpoints. Only minor observation: ~99.9% of seed data has empty brand → top_brand displays 'Unknown' (data, not code).
